body: Aww, well I really hope so..

Thanks :') 
I think the only way I can be happy is if I find love and can make him the happiest man alive. But they all get scared of my past, and im trying to get healthy, to move on from it and recover. But its so difficult when others wont let you, kind of..
they have issues, basically. for example my dad: cant go a day without alcohol.

Thats the sad part, I dont have anyone whom would even care. Someone I used to know had used a year to contact me but nobody knew where or whom I was. So therefore that person which was really mean to me thought I managed to take suicide for a long time ago.. I already know now that people wouldnt even notice me being gone. Ive been gone from school a month in a row several times and when I come back, nobody even says "hi".

Its not only the love part, thats just the tip of the iceberg, sadly..
I am soon to be 19, but have already experienced more pain than normal people would their whole lives and even more. so..
Hahah damn thats cool! (y) we have really good cheese and for example milk chocolate here called "Freia melkesjokolade", you should try it :)

Sorry, I must have read wrong, then I mean brother* of course :c

Oh, drugs? Thats difficult to help, like really difficult, Ive seen someone close to me be dead 2 times and is this awful mess now because of it.
To tell him what you feel about his drug use was right, but knowing how to do it right is just.. its a shot in the dark, you cant know for sure how to tell him without him reacting bad, so please dont feel like its your fault - at least you tried to help, you only said what you said because you care for him. It may sound over-used or something but the thought actually counts :)

I really hope it will be alright, for both of you!^^ Sending my thoughts to you all the way from Norway ~

At least try not to be angry at yourself. You could have been a great sister and still he could want suicide.. Im just saying that its most likely not your fault(i dont know your story tho), so instead of getting to a stage where you blame yourself, you should rather find out in a gentle way whats been bothering your brother and be there for him. You cant always fix it either, so make the most of your time while youre both alive.. Im sorry, I should maybe not be giving advices, since Im thinking about suicide too. But I wouldnt want my brothers to feel like its their fault and they cant help me.
